en-US: Build 209 device-test candidate includes the Office, IDE document tabs, Git initialization, native mind map and Shell repairs from build 207. Please also test cross-task history reading and its final answer, including long history and interrupted tasks; local-model tool calls, context compression and recoverable failures; and the separate Linux, Python, Node and WASM package entries. Linux-selected Shell, local Python and background services share a backend and Python environment; package management uses the selected environment consistently, including a stopped Linux environment without falling back to native storage. TinyEMU has passed a focused cloud test with real HTTPS APT installation, NumPy, Node and Python HTTPS. A downloadable Linux image still requires the final image/source bundle and is not yet offered. Native execution remains the default. Verification is limited to focused code checks and the cloud App build; please perform device acceptance. Office recovery copies are retained, but an engine process failure may still require restarting the App.
zh-Hans: Build 209 真机测试候选版，包含 207 的 Office、IDE 内部文档标签、Git 初始化、原生思维导图和 Shell 修复。请额外测：跨任务读取历史后能否给出最终答复，包含长历史与中断后继续；本地模型调用工具、上下文压缩与失败恢复；Linux、Python、Node、WASM 各自的包管理入口。Linux 环境的 Shell、local Python 和后台服务共用后端及 Python 环境，包管理使用选中的环境；Linux 停止时会明确报错，不会误写原生包目录。TinyEMU 云端定向测试已跑通真实 HTTPS APT 安装、NumPy、Node 和 Python HTTPS；可下载镜像仍待最终镜像及源码材料完成，目前尚未提供。默认继续使用原生执行。本轮只做定向代码检查和云端 App 构建，请你进行真机验收。Office 恢复副本会保留，但引擎进程真正失败后仍可能需要重启 App。
